name: Color Palette
description: Field input widget supporting launching of color palette with pre-approved color options.
project_description:
Color Palette module provides a widget that launches a color palette with a pre-approved color options for capturing entity field inputs. 

 Demo on YouTube 

 
 Unlike any other colorpicker, this widget only shows configured set of color(managed over a taxonomy) options in the palette. Further, color palette could be configured per field level to filter palette color options with say, Light colors only, Dark colors only, both Light & Dark colors etc.

 Color palette widget collect color input value in hexcode for entity fields. Example value, #ff0000, #00ff00 etc. This widget supports 'Text' and 'Taxonomy Term' field type at the moment.
